en.s: The siege of Antioch took place during the First Crusade in 1097 and 1098, on the Crusaders' way to Jerusalem through Syria. Two sieges took place in succession. The Crusaders sieged the city held by the Seljuk Empire from 20 October 1097 to 3 June 1098, when the Crusaders successfully took the city. A Seljuk relieving army then sieged the Crusaders for three weeks in late June.

zh.s: 安条克围城战发生于1097年至1098年第一次十字军东征期间，是十字军经叙利亚前往耶路撒冷途中发生的战事。围城分为前后两场：十字军于1097年10月20日至1098年6月3日围困由塞尔柱帝国控制的城市，最终成功攻占。随后，塞尔柱帝国援军又围困十字军3周，时间在6月下旬。

en.s: The Battle of Montenaken was fought between the forces of Liège and the Burgundian State on 20 October 1465 as part of the First Liège War. Although outnumbered, the Burgundian force succeeded in routing the militia of Liège, inflicting heavy casualties.

zh.s: 蒙特纳肯战役于1465年10月20日在列日与勃艮第国之间爆发，是第一次列日战争的一部分。勃艮第军队虽然人数较少，仍击溃了列日民兵，造成其重大伤亡。

en.s: On October 20, 1547, Gonzalo Pizarro’s forces defeated an army led by Diego Centeno at Huarina, near Lake Titicaca in present-day Bolivia.

zh.t: 皮萨罗的军队在瓦里纳击败森特诺
zh.s: 1547年10月20日，贡萨洛·皮萨罗的军队在瓦里纳击败迭戈·森特诺率领的军队。战场位于的的喀喀湖附近，属今玻利维亚境内。

en.s: The Battle of Axtorna or simply Axtorna, was a battle fought between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Kingdom of Denmark 20 October 1565 at Axtorna, a small village in what is today Falkenberg Municipality, Halland County in south-western Sweden.

zh.s: 阿克斯托纳战役又称阿克斯托纳之战，于1565年10月20日在瑞典王国和丹麦王国之间爆发，地点是阿克斯托纳村；该村现位于瑞典西南部哈兰省法尔肯贝里市镇。

en.s: The Battle of Jodoigne was fought October 20th 1568 between Spanish and Dutch forces. The Spanish under Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, 3rd Duke of Alba destroyed the rear guard of William the Silent's invading army, forcing him to abandon his invasion of the Netherlands and to retreat into Germany. The Dutch outnumbered the Spanish army, but were caught off-guard by the Spanish attack.

zh.s: 若多涅战役于1568年10月20日在西班牙军队与荷兰军队之间爆发。阿尔瓦公爵费尔南多·阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多率领西班牙军队，击溃了沉默者威廉入侵军的后卫部队，迫使其放弃入侵尼德兰并撤回德国。荷兰军队人数更多，但遭到西班牙军队突袭，未能及时防备。

en.s: In August 1572, during the course of the Eighty Years' War, the city of Goes, in the Spanish Netherlands, was besieged by Dutch forces, including several English volunteers. This was a menace to the safety of the nearby city of Middelburg, also under siege. Given the impossibility of rescue of Goes by sea, 3,000 soldiers of the Spanish Tercios under the command of Cristóbal de Mondragón waded across the river Scheldt at its mouth, walking 15 miles overnight in water up to chest deep.

zh.s: 1572年8月，八十年战争期间，荷兰军队及数名英国志愿者围攻西属尼德兰的荷斯城。这威胁到附近同样遭围攻的米德尔堡的安全。由于无法从海上救援荷斯，克里斯托瓦尔·德·蒙德拉贡率领3000名西班牙特西奥军团士兵，从斯海尔德河入海口涉水渡河；他们在齐胸深的水中连夜行进15英里。

en.s: The Battle of Coutras, fought on 20 October 1587, was a major engagement in the French Religious Wars between a Huguenot (Protestant) army under Henry of Navarre (the future Henry IV) and a royalist army led by Anne, Duke of Joyeuse. Henry of Navarre was victorious, and Joyeuse was killed while attempting to surrender.

zh.s: 库特拉战役于1587年10月20日爆发，是法国宗教战争期间的一场重要战斗。纳瓦拉的亨利（后来的亨利四世）率领胡格诺派新教军队，与乔伊斯公爵安妮率领的王党军队交战。纳瓦拉的亨利获胜，乔伊斯在试图投降时被杀。

en.s: The Battle of Bucov or Teleajen River (called battle of Bukowo in Polish historiography) was fought during the Moldavian Magnate Wars between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Principality of Wallachia, on October 20, 1600. Polish-Lithuanian forces under the command of Jan Zamoyski and Moldavian army of Ieremia Movilă defeated the Wallachian forces commanded by Michael the Brave.

zh.s: 布科夫战役又称特莱亚任河战役，有时在波兰史学中称为布科沃战役，于1600年10月20日在摩尔达维亚权贵战争期间爆发。扬·扎莫伊斯基指挥的波兰-立陶宛联邦军队和耶雷米亚·莫维勒指挥的摩尔达维亚军队击败了勇者米哈伊率领的瓦拉几亚军队。

en.s: The Battle of Bordeaux was a naval engagement of the Franco-Spanish War of 1635 fought on 20 October 1653 in the Gironde estuary. A Spanish fleet under Álvaro de Bazán, 3rd Marquis of Santa Cruz, sent to relieve Bordeaux, at that time held by the nobles rose up against Louis XIV during the Fronde, encountered a great concentration of French warships belonging to Duke of Vendome's army in the channel of Blaye and captured or destroyed most of it. Shortly after a landing was made by some 1,600 soldiers of the Spanish Tercios which sacked the village of Montagne-sur-Gironde.

zh.s: 波尔多海战是1635年法西战争期间的一场海战，于1653年10月20日在吉伦特河口爆发。圣克鲁斯侯爵阿尔瓦罗·德·巴赞率领西班牙舰队前往解围，当时波尔多被投石党起义的贵族占据，以反抗路易十四。西班牙舰队在布莱海峡遇到旺多姆公爵军队的一支法国舰队，后者兵力集中。西班牙军队俘获或摧毁了其中大多数法舰。不久后，约1,600名西班牙三分队士兵登陆并劫掠了吉伦特河畔蒙塔涅村。

en.s: The Battle of Clausen (or Klausen) was fought on 20 October 1735 near the town of Klausen (usually spelled in histories with 'C' instead of 'K'), which was then in the Electorate of Trier and part of the Holy Roman Empire, and is now in the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate. French forces under the command of Marshal François de Franquetot de Coigny were defeated in an attempt to dislodge imperial troops under the command of Friedrich Heinrich von Seckendorff.

zh.s: 克劳森战役又称克劳森（Klausen）战役，于1735年10月20日在克劳森镇附近爆发。当时该镇属于神圣罗马帝国的特里尔选侯国，现属德国莱茵兰-普法尔茨州。弗朗索瓦·德·弗朗凯托·德·科尼元帅指挥的法军试图驱逐弗里德里希·海因里希·冯·塞肯多夫指挥的帝国军队，但遭到击败。

en.s: The Battle of Bucharest took place on 20 October 1771 and was an important event of the Russo-Turkish war. It occurred when the Ottomans tried to recapture Bucharest from the Russians. In the summer of 1771, Russia launched an offensive against the Turkish positions along the Danube, attacking Giurgiu, but this turned out to be unsuccessful and the initiative in actions passed to the Ottomans.

zh.s: 布加勒斯特战役于1771年10月20日爆发，是俄土战争期间的一场重要战斗。奥斯曼军队试图从俄军手中夺回布加勒斯特。1771年夏季，俄军沿多瑙河进攻土军阵地，并攻打久尔久，但未能成功，战场主动权随后转到奥斯曼军队一方。

en.t: American Revolution: The Continental Association, a nonconsumption and nonimportation agreement against the British Isles and the British West Indies, is adopted by the First Continental Congress
en.s: The Continental Association, also known as the Articles of Association or simply the Association, was an agreement among the American colonies, adopted by the First Continental Congress, which met inside Carpenters' Hall in Philadelphia on October 20, 1774. It was a result of the escalating American Revolution, and called for a trade boycott against British merchants by the colonies.

zh.s: 大陆协会又称《协会条款》或简称《协会》，是美国各殖民地之间的一项协议，由第一届大陆会议于1774年10月20日在费城木匠厅通过。协议是在美国革命不断升级的背景下达成，号召各殖民地抵制与英国商人的贸易。

en.s: The action of 20 October 1778 was an inconclusive engagement between the French ship-of-the-line Triton and British ship-of-the-line Jupiter with a frigate Medea that took place off Cape Finisterre in the Bay of Biscay. Darkness separated the combatants before any decisive result was obtained.

zh.s: 1778年10月20日，法国战列舰“特里同”号和英国战列舰“朱庇特”号及护卫舰“美狄亚”号在比斯开湾菲尼斯特雷角外海交战，双方未分胜负。天色转暗后，交战双方分开，战斗未能决出结果。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Spartel was an indecisive naval battle between a Franco-Spanish fleet under Admiral Luis de Córdova y Córdova and a British fleet under Admiral of the Blue Richard Howe. These forces met on 20 October 1782 after Howe successfully resupplied Gibraltar, then under siege by Bourbon forces during the American Revolutionary War.

zh.s: 斯帕特尔角海战是法国和西班牙舰队与英国舰队之间的一场未分胜负的海战。法国-西班牙舰队由路易斯·德·科尔多瓦·科尔多瓦海军上将指挥，英国舰队由蓝中将理查德·豪指挥。豪成功向被波旁势力围困的直布罗陀补给后，两支舰队于1782年10月20日交战。

en.s: The action of 20 October 1793 was fought off Cape Barfleur in the English Channel during the War of the First Coalition. The early months of the year had seen a number of French frigates raiding British merchant shipping in the Channel, and HMS Crescent under Captain James Saumarez was deployed to watch the port of Cherbourg-en-Cotentin with the aim of disrupting the operations of the French frigates Réunion and Sémillante that were based in the harbour.

zh.s: 1793年10月20日，第一次反法同盟战争期间，英法两国在英吉利海峡巴夫勒尔角外海交战。当年早些时候，多艘法国护卫舰曾在海峡袭击英国商船。詹姆斯·索马雷兹船长指挥的英国皇家海军“新月”号奉命监视瑟堡港，试图阻止驻扎在港内的法国护卫舰“重逢”号和“坚定”号行动。

en.s: The Ulm campaign was a series of French and Bavarian military maneuvers and battles to outflank and capture an Austrian army in 1805 during the War of the Third Coalition. It took place in the vicinity of and inside the Swabian city of Ulm. The French Grande Armée, led by Emperor Napoleon, had 210,000 troops organized into seven corps and hoped to knock out the Austrian army in the Danube before Russian reinforcements could arrive.

zh.s: 乌尔姆战役行动是1805年法国和巴伐利亚军队为迂回并围歼奥地利军队而进行的一系列军事调动和战斗，发生于第三次反法同盟战争期间。战事发生在施瓦本城市乌尔姆及周边地区。拿破仑皇帝率领的法国大军共有21万名士兵，编为7个军，目标是在俄罗斯援军抵达多瑙河前击溃奥地利军队。

en.s: The Second Battle of Polotsk (18–20 October 1812) took place during Napoleon's invasion of Russia. In this encounter the Russians under General Peter Wittgenstein attacked and defeated a Franco-Bavarian force under Laurent Gouvion Saint-Cyr. In the aftermath of this success, the Russians took Polotsk and dismantled Napoleon's operations in Belarus. Wittgenstein's victory set the stage for the Battle of Berezina in November, in which three Russian armies converged on Napoleon from separate directions.

zh.s: 波洛茨克第二次战役于1812年10月18日至20日进行，是拿破仑入侵俄罗斯期间的一场战斗。彼得·维特根施泰因将军率领的俄军进攻并击败洛朗·古维翁-圣西尔指挥的法巴联军。俄军随后占领波洛茨克，摧毁了拿破仑在白俄罗斯的军事行动。维特根施泰因的胜利为11月别列津纳河战役铺平道路，届时三支俄军将从不同方向合围拿破仑。

en.t: Britain and the United States sign the Convention of 1818
en.s: On October 20, 1818, Britain and the United States signed the Convention of 1818 in London. It addressed fishing rights and North American boundary disputes, including joint use of the Oregon Country.

zh.t: 英国与美国在伦敦签署《1818年公约》
zh.s: 1818年10月20日，英国与美国在伦敦签署《1818年公约》，处理渔业权和北美边界争议，并约定共同使用俄勒冈地区。

en.s: The Battle of Navarino was a naval battle fought on 20 October 1827, during the Greek War of Independence (1821–32), in Navarino Bay (modern-day Pylos), on the west coast of the Peloponnese peninsula, in the Ionian Sea. An Ottoman armada, which, in addition to imperial warships, included squadrons from the eyalets (provinces) of Egypt, Tunis and Algiers, was destroyed by an Allied force of British, French and Russian vessels. It was the last major naval battle in history to be fought entirely with sailing ships, although most ships fought at anchor. The Allies' victory was achieved through superior firepower and gunnery.

zh.s: 纳瓦里诺海战于1827年10月20日爆发，是希腊独立战争（1821–32）期间的一场海战，战场位于爱奥尼亚海伯罗奔尼撒半岛西岸的纳瓦里诺湾（今皮洛斯）。奥斯曼舰队除帝国军舰外，还包括来自埃及、突尼斯和阿尔及尔省的分舰队，最终被英国、法国和俄罗斯舰艇组成的盟军摧毁。这是历史上最后一场完全由帆船进行的重大海战，尽管大多数船只是在锚泊状态下作战。盟军凭借更强的火力和炮术获胜。

La Vallette of the first-class frigate USS Congress in company with the sloop USS Portsmouth forced the Mexican garrison of Guaymas to evacuate the city under the threat of bombardment, then dismantled the seaward defenses of the city and thereafter controlled the city by the threat of bombardment by a sloop of war kept on station at the mouth of the harbor.

zh.s: 1847年10月20日，埃利·A·F·拉瓦莱特船长指挥一级护卫舰“国会”号，并与单桅帆船“朴茨茅斯”号同行。在炮击威胁下，墨西哥瓜伊马斯驻军被迫撤出该城。美军随后拆除了该城面海一侧的防御工事，并让一艘战争单桅帆船驻守港口入口，以炮击威胁控制该城。

en.s: The Battle of Rybnica, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on October 20, 1863, near the village of Rybnica, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of 650 Polish insurgents, commanded by Dionizy Czachowski, clashed with a 500-strong detachment of the Imperial Russian Army. The clash ended in rebel victory; Russian losses were estimated at app. 50–60 killed, while Poles lost 27 killed and 30 wounded. On October 20, Czachowski and his party crossed the Vistula river, and headed northwards. News of the insurgent unit presence reached the town of Staszow, in which stationed a Russian garrison of infantry and dragoons.

zh.s: 雷布尼察战役是波兰一月起义期间多场交战之一，于1863年10月20日在当时属于俄属波兰王国的雷布尼察村附近爆发。狄奥尼齐·恰霍夫斯基率领650名波兰起义军，与500人的俄罗斯帝国军队分队交战，起义军获胜。据估计，俄军有约50至60人死亡；波兰军队有27人死亡、30人受伤。10月20日，恰霍夫斯基率部渡过维斯瓦河，向北行进。消息传到斯塔舒夫镇后，驻扎在当地的俄军步兵和龙骑兵驻军得知起义军已在附近。

en.s: The Battle of Philadelphia (October 20, 1863) saw the Confederate cavalry brigades of Colonels J. J. Morrison and George Gibbs Dibrell attack a Union cavalry brigade under Colonel Frank Wolford at Philadelphia, Tennessee, during the Knoxville campaign of the American Civil War. While Dibrell's brigade skirmished with Wolford's cavalrymen, Morrison led his brigade around the west side of Philadelphia to attack the Union force from the rear.

zh.s: 费城战役于1863年10月20日在美国内战诺克斯维尔战役期间，于田纳西州费城镇及周边地区爆发。邦联军骑兵上校J·J·莫里森和乔治·吉布斯·迪布雷尔率部袭击了弗兰克·沃尔福德上校指挥的联邦骑兵旅。迪布雷尔的部队与沃尔福德的骑兵交战时，莫里森率部绕至费城镇西侧，从后方攻击联邦军。

en.s: The Treaty of Ancón was a peace treaty signed by Chile and Peru on 20 October 1883, in Ancón, near Lima. It was intended to settle the two nations' remaining territorial differences at the conclusion of their involvement in the War of the Pacific and to stabilise post-bellum relations between them. Under the treaty's terms, Chile gained control over Tarapacá.

zh.s: 《安孔条约》是智利和秘鲁于1883年10月20日在利马附近的安孔签署的一项和平条约，旨在解决两国在太平洋战争结束时尚未解决的领土争端，并稳定战后的关系。根据条约条款，智利获得塔拉帕卡的控制权。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1919 was the 15th general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. en.t: The Sydney Opera House is opened by Elizabeth II after 14 years of construction
en.s: The Sydney Opera House is a multi-venue performing arts centre in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. Located on the foreshore of Sydney Harbour, it is widely regarded as one of the world's most famous and distinctive buildings, and a masterpiece of 20th-century architecture. Designed by Danish architect Jørn Utzon and completed by an Australian architectural team headed by Peter Hall, the building was formally opened by Queen Elizabeth II on 20 October 1973, 16 years after Utzon's 1957 selection as winner of an international design competition.

en.s: A general election took place in Japan on October 20, 1996. Incumbent Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto of the coalition of the Liberal Democratic Party, New Party Sakigake and the Social Democratic Party won the election. This is the first election under new elections rules established in 1993 with single non-transferable vote, single-member districts, and some seats being distributed according to proportional representation. Before this election, each district was represented by multiple members, sometimes from the same party, causing intra-party competition. Under the new rules, each district has only one representative now representing a wide range of interests for his or her district.

en.t: Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions
en.s: The UNESCO Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions is a binding international legal instrument and UNESCO convention adopted by the UNESCO General Conference on 20 October 2005, during the 33rd session of the UNESCO General Conference held in Paris, France on 3–21 October 2005. The convention compliments the previously established provisions of UNESCO including the Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity of 2001. "The Convention recognises the rights of Parties to take measures to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions, and impose obligations at both domestic and international levels on Parties."

zh.t: 《保护和促进文化表现形式多样性公约》

en.t: Muammar Gaddafi, a former leader of Libya, was murdered by the National Transitional Council (NTC) on 20 October 2011 after the Battle of Sirte
en.s: Muammar Gaddafi, a former leader of Libya, was murdered by the National Transitional Council (NTC) on 20 October 2011 after the Battle of Sirte. Gaddafi was captured by NTC forces and killed extrajudicially shortly afterwards. The NTC initially claimed Gaddafi succumbed to injuries sustained in a firefight when loyalist forces attempted to free him, although a video of his last moments shows rebel fighters dragging Gaddafi out of a drainage pipe, beating him and one of them sodomizing him with a bayonet before he was shot several times.
